concerns.text: FR-013 defines `exposure_level` as “the proportion of comments the user has viewed from identified idealized‑self‑presentation subreddits within a 30‑day observation window.” This metric cannot be derived from the available Reddit comment dump because the dump contains only the user’s own comments, not the set of posts the user actually viewed. Consequently the required input is unreachable, violating Constitution Principle VI (Distinct Data Stream Integrity) and making the requirement untestable.
